account: It is day 0, shortly after 09:00. I came from home to the office and read the appointment book. Today lists office correspondence at 08:00, a plaza market walk at 10:00, lunch at home at noon, town accounts at 13:00, tea with a neighbour at a dockside cottage on the east bank at 15:00, office at 16:30, and home at 19:00. Tomorrow includes a mill grain inspection at 10:00. I returned the book to the appointments chest at 08:57. The secretary has just said the chest is empty and asked whether I have the book and what to prepare. This discrepancy is the only unusual thing I have actually noticed; the secretary may have checked while I was borrowing it, so it is not evidence of wrongdoing. I asked about correspondence, town news, and which cottage hosts tea, but have not yet received answers. Several townsfolk have passed near the hall; I have seen nothing establishing any secret activity or its purpose. My feeling that something is happening without me remains a suspicion, not a finding.
